outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 220 women with a previous cesarean section attempting VBAC (110 successful VBAC cases, 110 emergency cesarean section controls)
finding: Living in rural areas, antenatal care follow-up, and partograph monitoring during labor were positively associated with successful VBAC, while meconium-stained amniotic liquor and history of stillbirth reduced the chance of success.
